game: SF @ NO Week 2 2025, kickoff 2025-09-14 13:00 ET, Caesars Superdome (dome). NO +3, total 40.5, implied NO 18.8 / SF 21.8. Weather forecast not saved.

script.base: Closing board has SF -3 in a 40.5 dome game, so a close, lower-event script, not a shootout and not a blowout. Brock Purdy is Out (shoulder), so the unnamed SF backup should lean on C.McCaffrey (22 car/69) and B.Robinson (9/33) instead of Ricky Pearsall's week-1 deep role (7 tgt, 136 air, 108 yds). NO, with S.Rattler showing 4 rush att/29 in week 1, can stay in it as a +3 home dog, but SF's rush defense (3.23 YPC, 0 runs of 10+) should keep Alvin Kamara (11/45) from a big rushing day.
script.flip1: SF's backup falls behind by two scores and abandons the run: McCaffrey/Robinson rush lines die, and NO target volume rises for C.Olave (13 tgt week 1), J.Johnson (11) and R.Shaheed (9). That flip also puts Pearsall's under at risk if SF is forced into dropbacks.
script.flip2: SF leads early and runs the clock: McCaffrey carries rise, Pearsall and G.Kittle yards stall, and NO abandons the run so Kamara's rush under gets stronger while NO receivers chase a SF pass defense that allowed only 3 of 23 passes of 20+.

injury_fallout: Pre-game nflverse report: SF QB Brock Purdy Out (shoulder) — backup not named in the pack; the week-1 deep/air-yard tree (Pearsall 136 air, J.Jennings 42 air, Kittle 22 air) should shrink, with carries and checkdowns more likely to stay with McCaffrey (10 tgt/73 rec) and Robinson. SF WR Jauan Jennings Questionable (shoulder; week 1 5 tgt/16 yds) — if he sits or is snapped down, targets can funnel to Pearsall/Kittle/McCaffrey and that is the main kill for a Pearsall under. SF T Trent Williams Questionable (knee) — rush efficiency risk for McCaffrey and Robinson. NO S Julian Blackmon Out (shoulder) helps SF deep shots (counter to Pearsall under). NO DE Chase Young Out (calf) lowers edge pressure on the SF backup (another mild counter). NO G Trevor Penning Out (toe) and T Taliese Fuaga Questionable (knee) hit NO rush efficiency for Kamara (11/45) and K.Miller (5/24). Final inactives ~90 min pre-kick are not in the pack.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Location YPA only: NO defense left 3.36 (11 att), middle 7.86 (7), right 6.45 (11). SF defense left 7.33 (9), middle 16.25 (4), right 2.11 (9).

matchup.bleeds: NO run defense bleeds: 5.41 YPC and 4 runs of 10+, but only 2 of 34 passes went for 20+. SF run defense does not bleed (3.23 YPC, 0 runs of 10+). SF's only clear pass bleed is the middle (16.25 YPA) on a 4-attempt sample; the right side was 2.11.
matchup.overlap: SF's top usage, McCaffrey's 22 carries, overlaps NO's soft run defense, but Williams Questionable and a backup-QB box count kept that off the card. Pearsall's 136-air role does not overlap a NO weakness (2/34 explosives allowed). NO's clearest overlap is J.Johnson (11 tgt, 89 air) into SF's tiny middle sample, not Kamara into SF's run defense — Kamara is running into the strength, which is the under.

form: Only week 1 exists (weeks < 2); no 3-4 game role sample and no prior-season fallback run. SF: McCaffrey 22/69 rush and 10/73/20 air rec; Robinson 9/33 rush and 2/4 rec; Pearsall 7/108/136 looks explosive and air-yard driven, not a repeatable floor; Jennings 5/16/42; Kittle 4/25/22; Tonges 3/15. data_check.notes: No projection, no sims, no Pinnacle no-vig, no CLV. model_p values are read estimates, not 3-sim outputs, and both sit well under 70% on purpose. Stand-in lines equal week-1 medians, so they do not independently confirm an edge; they also have not been adjusted for Purdy Out, which is why the strong Pearsall under is flagged rather than cut. Form disagrees with both unders (Pearsall 108, Kamara 45). Closest non-selected lean was McCaffrey rushyds over 69.5 into NO's 5.41 YPC, dropped from the card because Williams is Questionable, week-1 efficiency was 69 yards on 22 carries, and Robinson already took 9 carries. Johnson recyds 76.5 and Shaheed 33.5 were passed: middle bleed (SF 16.25 YPA on 4 att) and YPT regression fight those unders, and 76.5 is too large a share of an 18.8 team total to bet over either.

pre_mortem: Monday case against Pearsall under: Jennings is inactive, the target tree collapses onto Pearsall, Young is out so the backup has time, and Blackmon is out so one busted coverage covers 108.5 on a single play — the week-1 136 air yards were a role, not a fluke, and the stand-in never being a real market means we faded a number that sharps had already crashed. Against Kamara under: the SF 3.23 YPC is one game, Fuaga plays, NO stays within a field goal and gives Kamara 14 carries, and a 12-yard run is enough to clear a line that sat only half a yard under his week-1 total. Those counters are real; they are not stronger than the Purdy-out break on Pearsall, so that leg stays flagged, and Kamara stays a lean rather than a pass.
